title: maint.event.v1{kind=trainer_warmup_hint}
description: Phase 8 §8.14.8 — soft warm-up advisory emitted by maint.scaler.v1 on retrain_request. Replaces scale_decision{source=retrain_request_warmup}. The trainer MAY consume to pre-warm capacity; no ack is expected and no replica change is mandated by the scaler. The trainer remains the sole writer of its own replica count.

target.description: Self-scaling target being hinted (trainer.v1 in v1).

retrain_request_id.description: Correlates back to the originating retrain_request envelope.

projected_window_s.description: Scaler decision-window duration in seconds — hint for trainer pre-warm budget.
